GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-03-22T19:40:35Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Possible to add a static method on a union type?
Description: I'm using C like a companion object in Scala:

``` ts
interface A {
  a: number
}
interface B {
  b: number
}
class C {
  a: number
  b: number
  static c(d: number): number {...}
}
```

How do I express that `C = A|B`? I can do

``` ts
interface A {...}
interface B {...}
type C = A|B
```

But then I lose the static method
